Contact ALT ('map-walk') keeps its own media, MV-09-alt, inside a CameraGroup drift, because LivePlate picks loops by plates.loops and not by contact.lastlight. DEFAULT uses <LivePlate media=MV-08> (loopFor gives MV-09; under plates.loops:alt it gives MV-09-alt).

B54 stays a tag on room 3 in both choreographies. I did not register it as a spotlight scroll star; like other existing scroll signatures, nothing registers it. It would cost about 70 B first-load if the assembler wants it.
The hp-map hint in the Lumos ALT (under the ceiling band) is my own placement; the spec only places it on the Map banner.

Wand cursor and bloom: our own plain drawing (an SVG data URI, a tapered stick with a grip and a bone outline), served via image-set 1x/2x with a url() fallback. The bloom is a pre-rendered radial SVG image (Law 1). Bloom strength is 1 on the parchment and the hall, 0.45 on the ALT night sky where light text sits. It is always below text (z-index −10 layers, or the act-4 hall plate layer).

The act-4 wand zone uses the existing [data-wand-zone] on the ignite and ignite-lumos hall layers (W2-CARDS files, unchanged). The cursor shows there only while the pointer is over a zone whose inline opacity is above 0.5, by toggling data-wand-in on #act-4 (a section, never <html>).
